title: call.started
description: Media is up: the caller and the agent can hear each other, or the text session is open. Everything the agent says and hears comes after this.

CallStarted.description: Media is up: the caller and the agent can hear each other, or the text session is open. Everything the agent says and hears comes after this.

from.description: The calling side, E.164 or a visitor id.

run.description: The eval run that opened this call, when one did: such a call starts mid-conversation, in the golden's state. Absent or null for a person.

persona.description: The synthetic caller that opened this call, by name (GET /v1/personas), when a simulation did. Absent or null for a person: nobody is playing anybody.

accepts_when.description: When that caller hangs up satisfied, as the persona said it when the call opened. Carried on the call's own first entry so the judge at hang-up — and any judging later — read the rule the call was made under, whatever the persona says since. Absent or null: no rule, and no `persona` judge on this call.

declines_when.description: When that caller hangs up unsatisfied, as the persona said it when the call opened. The other half of the same rule; absent or null with `accepts_when` absent is a call nobody judges for it.

caller.description: Who is on the line, as far as the platform knows now.

started_at.description: When media came up, unix seconds.

env.description: The world this call ran in: the one the key that holds its agent opens. Absent on entries written before keys knew where they were, which read as production.
